race.comment: Race knocked around by scratchings, which leaves YOU SAID WHAT (12) as top pick. Wasn't disgraced at Wangaratta last time and this looks a step below that class wise. Drawing the inside alley was the icing on the cake. SACRE BLEU (2) has had seven starts, but most in better races than this and will be better for a couple of jumpouts. His problem is the wide gate but the fact he's running is a good sign the stable thinks he might be able to overcome it. MILLSY'S AWARD (1) was woeful on debut but was put away after it and ran a much improved race last time out. Will have taken fitness benefit from that and suited up in trip. BELLE FLAME (5) hasn't done much in two trials this time in, but this is a suitable distance first up and the form last prep matches up nicely for this type of race.
